target: zero for every scope listed here — a consumer names its @prisma/orm-* facade and its extension packs, nothing else (ADR 242). `threshold` counts lines naming an internal @prisma-next/* package; `manifestThreshold` counts internal packages a consumer package.json declares (dependencies + devDependencies, excluding @repo/tsconfig, which is consumed via `extends` and never imported). Both may only ever go down. TML-3129 drives them to zero.
notScoped: Most of test/ is deliberately absent. test/integration/test/{ports,fixtures,sql-orm-client,sql-builder,authoring,mongo,...} exercise internal packages directly — that is their job, and rewriting them onto a facade would test the facade's re-exports instead of the code under test, reducing coverage. Only the consumer-shaped subtrees are scoped: test/e2e/framework, which stands in for an application, and test/integration/test/cli-journeys, which drives the CLI the way a user does. cli-journeys reads zero manifest packages because it owns no package.json; its dependencies come from test/integration, which legitimately declares internal packages and is out of scope for the same reason as the suites above.
